text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.title: Config
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.fixNet: Disables nether fog with environmental fog enabled.
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.flashb: Enables copying LoDs to special folder (doesn't support combining replays). If turned off, LoD location will be written to metadata instead (can't be ingested in the replay).
Enables ingesting in compatible replays (which have LoD copied).
If enabled, checks all replays on launch and deletes copied LoDs for deleted replays. Saves disk space.
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.server: Allows blacklisting servers to disable Voxy in them. Add in Cloth Config.
Each field represents a single server.
Allows whitelisting servers to enable Voxy only on them. Add in Cloth Config.
Each field represents a single server.
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.lodMir: Allows setting one LoD storage for multiple servers. Add in Cloth Config.
Each field represents a single server.
Format for every field: BaseIP AltIP AltIP
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.worldS:
Stores LoDs by world instead of by address, so every entrance to the same world shares one cache and no mirror list has to be kept up to date. Takes priority over LoD Mirror.
Only applies on remote servers; singleplayer, Realms, replays and servers that report no world (waiting rooms) keep storing LoDs by address exactly as before.
Folders written before this was enabled are left behind untouched and can be deleted by hand. The storage backend settings file stays per address, so a single entrance cannot be pointed at its own backend.
Anything that wipes LoDs by deleting a server's address folder will silently miss the world folder.
Copying LoDs alongside Flashback replays is not supported while this is on.
Two unrelated servers that report the same world seed, such as a copied world or minigames built from one seed, share a single folder.
Do not enable this on servers that randomise or rotate the world seed they report: every connection would start a new folder.
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.disabl: Disables Voxy when playing in a local singleplayer world.
text.autoconfig.voxy-extra.option.replay: Allows writing world folder name in replay metadata to load correct LoDs in singleplayer replays.
Allows loading LoDs in replays (Read-Only). May load wrong LoDs in singleplayer replays when "Save Custom Meta" was disabled.
